\label{lesson:GU-R16-naam-r4}



\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
{[}YOU SAY: \emph{chhe — nām — mārũ}{]} Point to the item meaning \emph{name}, then uncover \textbf{\gu{નામ}} and read it once. Position 97 is 61 lessons after its introduction at position 36, so this response closes the word's R4 window.

\end{tcolorbox}
